sections.title: Digital Marketing, Communications, and Media Innovation
sections.description: Digital Marketing, Communications, and Media Innovation explores the technological, economic, and cultural forces reshaping contemporary marketing, communications, and media industries. Students examine key topics including platformization, audience behavior, attention economics, the creator economy, commerce media, artificial intelligence, and the ethical and governance challenges associated with emerging technologies. Through case analyses and experiential Client Labs, students apply concepts, frameworks, and strategic thinking to address real-world challenges facing organizations across the media, marketing, and communications landscape.
